entities.summary: Mark Christopher Hickman OAM is a field hockey goalkeeper from Australia. He was a part of the team that won the gold medal at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. Mark Hickman was a athletes & competitors from Darwin (b. 1973-08-22, Darwin). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
